note: COMPOSED demo device combining two real, independent single-fault missions on non-overlapping channel groups. Base: real coolingdegradation run UNIT-coolingdegradation-0037_M006 (cooling_health=0.5), rows 90-210 (renumbered t=0..120, mid-CLIMB) -- kept fully intact for every thermal channel (cht_c1-4, coolant_temperature, oil_temperature) in both telemetry and groundtruth. Overlay: the electrical columns ONLY (alternator_power, battery_voltage, battery_current -- telemetry AND groundtruth _true counterparts) were overwritten row-for-row (aligned by t, both windows starting at row 90 of their respective source missions) with the corresponding columns from a real alternatordegradation run (UNIT-alternatordegradation-0103_M003, alternator_health=0.5). map/power identities are unaffected since electrical columns don't participate in either identity. [Window starts mid-CLIMB (not at engine start-up) so altitude/engine_state/throttle vary from t=0 instead of sitting at IDLE/altitude=0 for the first ~60-90s of the original mission.]
